11 enum Resource derives ReadWriter:
12   case Wheat, Wood, Faith, Gold, Stone
13 
14 case class Cost(amount: Int, resource: Resource) derives ReadWriter
15 
16 case class Resources(
17     wheat: Double = 0.0,
18     wood: Double = 0.0,
19     faith: Double = 0.0,
20     gold: Int = 0,
21     stone: Double = 0.0
22 ) derives ReadWriter:
23   def get(resource: Resource): Double = resource match
24     case Resource.Wheat => wheat
25     case Resource.Wood  => wood
26     case Resource.Faith => faith
27     case Resource.Gold  => gold.toDouble
28     case Resource.Stone => stone
29 
30   def canAfford(cost: Cost): Boolean = get(cost.resource) >= cost.amount
31 
32   def canAfford(cost: Int, resource: Resource): Boolean = get(resource) >= cost
33 
34   def deduct(cost: Cost): Resources = deduct(cost.amount, cost.resource)
35 
36   def deduct(amount: Int, resource: Resource): Resources = resource match
37     case Resource.Wheat => copy(wheat = wheat - amount)
38     case Resource.Wood  => copy(wood = wood - amount)
39     case Resource.Faith => copy(faith = faith - amount)
40     case Resource.Gold  => copy(gold = gold - amount)
41     case Resource.Stone => copy(stone = stone - amount)
42 
43   def add(amount: Double, resource: Resource): Resources = resource match
44     case Resource.Wheat => copy(wheat = wheat + amount)
45     case Resource.Wood  => copy(wood = wood + amount)
46     case Resource.Faith => copy(faith = faith + amount)
47     case Resource.Gold  => copy(gold = gold + amount.toInt)
48     case Resource.Stone => copy(stone = stone + amount)

54 case class Coord(row: Int, col: Int) derives ReadWriter:
55   def neighbors: Set[Coord] = neighborsWithinRadius(1)
56 
57   def neighborsWithinRadius(radius: Int): Set[Coord] =
58     (for
59       rowOffset <- -radius to radius
60       colOffset <- -radius to radius
61       if !(rowOffset == 0 && colOffset == 0)
62     yield Coord(row + rowOffset, col + colOffset)).toSet
63 
64   /** Rectangle of coords in a direction from this coord (excluding self).
65     * length extends in the given direction, width extends perpendicular.
66     * For example, Up with length=5, halfWidth=1 gives a 3-wide, 5-tall rectangle above.
67     */
68   def rectangleInDirection(direction: BureauDirection, length: Int, halfWidth: Int): Set[Coord] =
69     direction match
70       case BureauDirection.Center => neighborsWithinRadius(2) // fallback to default radius
71       case BureauDirection.Up =>
72         (for
73           r <- -length to -1
74           c <- -halfWidth to halfWidth
75         yield Coord(row + r, col + c)).toSet
76       case BureauDirection.Down =>
77         (for
78           r <- 1 to length
79           c <- -halfWidth to halfWidth
80         yield Coord(row + r, col + c)).toSet
81       case BureauDirection.Left =>
82         (for
83           r <- -halfWidth to halfWidth
84           c <- -length to -1
85         yield Coord(row + r, col + c)).toSet
86       case BureauDirection.Right =>
87         (for
88           r <- -halfWidth to halfWidth
89           c <- 1 to length
90         yield Coord(row + r, col + c)).toSet
91

116 // Individual skill nodes within a branch
117 enum Skill derives ReadWriter:
118   // Agriculture branch (dual track at level 1, 2, and 3)
119   case Agriculture1A // Fields start at level 10
120   case Agriculture1B // Farms affect neighboring forests at 50% effectiveness
121   case Agriculture2A // Fields work 50% faster
122   case Agriculture2B // Farms affect neighboring quarries at 50% effectiveness
123   case Agriculture3A // Wheat field upgrade costs reduced by 99%
124   case Agriculture3B // Farms affect neighboring temples at 50% effectiveness
125   // Management branch (dual track at level 1, 2, and 3)
126   case Management1A // Bureau costs 0 wood to build and upgrades consume 0 wood
127   case Management1B // Bureau can be directed (5x3 rectangle instead of 2-tile radius)
128   case Management2A // Town halls cost 90% less stone to build
129   case Management2B // Town halls can be directed (5x3 rectangle instead of 2-tile radius)
130   case Management3A // Town halls can hold 2 politicians at the same time
131   case Management3B // Normal politicians have 2 effects, rare politicians have 3 effects
132   // Wisdom branch
133   case Wisdom1 // Quarries produce 25% more stone for each neighboring forest
134   case Wisdom2 // Each forest grants 50% increased faith production to neighboring temples
135   // Education branch
136   case Education1 // Academies are 10x cheaper
137   case Education2 // Academies have both modes active at the same time
138   // Logistics branch (dual track at level 1)
139   case Logistics1A // Bureau wood cost reduced by 90%
140   case Logistics1B // Bureau turbo faith cost reduced by 90%

142 object Skill:
143   // Get skill branch name
144   def branchName(skill: Skill): String = skill match
145     case Agriculture1A | Agriculture1B | Agriculture2A | Agriculture2B | Agriculture3A | Agriculture3B => "Agriculture"
146     case Management1A | Management1B | Management2A | Management2B | Management3A | Management3B => "Management"
147     case Wisdom1 | Wisdom2 => "Wisdom"
148     case Education1 | Education2 => "Education"
149     case Logistics1A | Logistics1B => "Logistics"
150 
151   // Get skill description
152   def description(skill: Skill): String = skill match
153     case Agriculture1A => "New wheat fields start at level 10"
154     case Agriculture1B => "Farms affect neighboring forests at 50% effectiveness"
155     case Agriculture2A => "Wheat fields produce twice as fast (50% shorter interval)"
156     case Agriculture2B => "Farms affect neighboring quarries at 50% effectiveness"
157     case Management1A => "Bureaus cost 0 wood to build and upgrade"
158     case Management1B => "Bureaus can be directed (5×3 rectangle)"
159     case Management2A => "Town halls cost 90% less stone to build"
160     case Management2B => "Town Halls can be directed (5×3 rectangle)"
161     case Management3A => "Town Halls hold 2 politicians at once"
162     case Management3B => "Normal politicians have 2 effects, rare have 3"
163     case Wisdom1 => "+25% quarry stone output per neighboring forest"
164     case Wisdom2 => "+50% temple faith output per neighboring forest"
165     case Education1 => "Academies cost 10x less stone to build"
166     case Education2 => "Academies run both modes simultaneously"
167     case Logistics1A => "Bureaus spend 90% less wood per upgrade (100→10)"
168     case Logistics1B => "Bureau turbo spends 90% less faith per upgrade"
169     case Agriculture3A => "Wheat field upgrade costs reduced by 99%"
170     case Agriculture3B => "Farms affect neighboring temples at 50% effectiveness"
171 
172   // Get skill cost
173   def cost(skill: Skill): Int = 1
174 
175   // Get skill tier (for grouping in UI, independent of cost)
176   def tier(skill: Skill): Int = skill match
177     case Agriculture1A | Agriculture1B => 1
178     case Agriculture2A | Agriculture2B => 2
179     case Agriculture3A | Agriculture3B => 3
180     case Management1A | Management1B => 1
181     case Management2A | Management2B => 2
182     case Management3A | Management3B => 3
183     case Wisdom1 => 1
184     case Wisdom2 => 2
185     case Education1 => 1
186     case Education2 => 2
187     case Logistics1A | Logistics1B => 1
188 
189   // Get prerequisite skill (if any)
190   def prerequisite(skill: Skill): Option[Skill] = skill match
191     case Agriculture1A | Agriculture1B | Management1A | Management1B | Wisdom1 | Education1 | Logistics1A | Logistics1B => None
192     case Agriculture2A | Agriculture2B => None // Either Agriculture1A or Agriculture1B, handled by alternativePrerequisites
193     case Agriculture3A | Agriculture3B => None // Either Agriculture2A or Agriculture2B, handled by alternativePrerequisites
194     case Management2A | Management2B => None // Either Management1A or Management1B, handled by alternativePrerequisites
195     case Management3A | Management3B => None // Either Management2A or Management2B, handled by alternativePrerequisites
196     case Wisdom2 => Some(Wisdom1)
197     case Education2 => Some(Education1)
198 
199   // Get alternative prerequisites (for dual track choices)
200   // Returns the set of skills where having ANY ONE unlocked satisfies the prerequisite
201   def alternativePrerequisites(skill: Skill): Option[Set[Skill]] = skill match
202     case Agriculture2A | Agriculture2B => Some(Set(Agriculture1A, Agriculture1B))
203     case Agriculture3A | Agriculture3B => Some(Set(Agriculture2A, Agriculture2B))
204     case Management2A | Management2B => Some(Set(Management1A, Management1B))
205     case Management3A | Management3B => Some(Set(Management2A, Management2B))
206     case _ => None
207 
208   // Get mutually exclusive skill (choosing one locks out the other)
209   def mutuallyExclusive(skill: Skill): Option[Skill] = skill match
210     case Agriculture1A => Some(Agriculture1B)
211     case Agriculture1B => Some(Agriculture1A)
212     case Agriculture2A => Some(Agriculture2B)
213     case Agriculture2B => Some(Agriculture2A)
214     case Agriculture3A => Some(Agriculture3B)
215     case Agriculture3B => Some(Agriculture3A)
216     case Management1A => Some(Management1B)
217     case Management1B => Some(Management1A)
218     case Management2A => Some(Management2B)
219     case Management2B => Some(Management2A)
220     case Management3A => Some(Management3B)
221     case Management3B => Some(Management3A)
222     case Logistics1A => Some(Logistics1B)
223     case Logistics1B => Some(Logistics1A)
224     case _ => None
225 
226   // Get all skills in a branch, in order (dual track alternatives grouped together)
227   def branchSkills(branchName: String): List[Skill] = branchName match
228     case "Agriculture" => List(Agriculture1A, Agriculture1B, Agriculture2A, Agriculture2B, Agriculture3A, Agriculture3B)
229     case "Management" => List(Management1A, Management1B, Management2A, Management2B, Management3A, Management3B)
230     case "Wisdom" => List(Wisdom1, Wisdom2)
231     case "Education" => List(Education1, Education2)
232     case "Logistics" => List(Logistics1A, Logistics1B)
233     case _ => List.empty
234 
235   // Get all branch names
236   val allBranches: List[String] = List("Agriculture", "Management", "Wisdom", "Education", "Logistics")
237 
238   // Get emoji for branch

240     case "Agriculture" => "🌾"
241     case "Management" => "📋"
242     case "Wisdom" => "📿"
243     case "Education" => "📚"
244     case "Logistics" => "🏛️"
245     case _ => "❓"

247 enum TileType:
248   case Empty
249   case WheatField(level: Int) // level determines production rate
250   case Farm(level: Int) // boosts nearby wheat fields
251   case Woodcutter(level: Int) // produces wood
252   case Bureau(level: Int) // auto-upgrades nearby buildings, costs wood
253   case Temple(level: Int) // produces faith, costs wood
254   case TownHall(politicians: List[Politician]) // holds politician(s) - Management3A allows 2
255   case Quarry(level: Int) // produces stone
256   case Academy(mode: AcademyMode) // boosts politician generation or rare chance
257   case Tavern // extends politician lifespan in nearby Town Halls by 2x
258 
259 object TileType:
260   /** Custom ReadWriter that handles backward-compatible deserialization.
261     * Old saves stored TownHall as {"\$type":"TownHall","politician":<Option>}.
262     * New format stores TownHall as {"\$type":"TownHall","politicians":<List>}.
263     */
264   given ReadWriter[TileType] = readwriter[ujson.Value].bimap[TileType](
265     // Write: serialize to JSON
266     {
267       case Empty => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Empty")
268       case WheatField(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "WheatField", "level" -> level)
269       case Farm(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Farm", "level" -> level)
270       case Woodcutter(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Woodcutter", "level" -> level)
271       case Bureau(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Bureau", "level" -> level)
272       case Temple(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Temple", "level" -> level)
273       case TownHall(politicians) =>
274         val polJson = upickle.default.writeJs(politicians)
275         ujson.Obj("$type" -> "TownHall", "politicians" -> polJson)
276       case Quarry(level) => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Quarry", "level" -> level)
277       case Academy(mode) =>
278         val modeJson = upickle.default.writeJs(mode)
279         ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Academy", "mode" -> modeJson)
280       case Tavern => ujson.Obj("$type" -> "Tavern")
281     },
282     // Read: deserialize from JSON, handling old Option format for TownHall
283     json =>
284       json("$type").str match
285         case "Empty" => Empty
286         case "WheatField" => WheatField(json("level").num.toInt)
287         case "Farm" => Farm(json("level").num.toInt)
288         case "Woodcutter" => Woodcutter(json("level").num.toInt)
289         case "Bureau" => Bureau(json("level").num.toInt)
290         case "Temple" => Temple(json("level").num.toInt)
291         case "TownHall" =>
292           // Backward compat: old format had "politician" (Option), new has "politicians" (List)
293           if json.obj.contains("politicians") then
294             val pols = upickle.default.read[List[Politician]](json("politicians"))
295             TownHall(pols)
296           else if json.obj.contains("politician") then
297             val polOpt = upickle.default.read[Option[Politician]](json("politician"))
298             TownHall(polOpt.toList)
299           else
300             TownHall(List.empty)
301         case "Quarry" => Quarry(json("level").num.toInt)
302         case "Academy" =>
303           val mode = upickle.default.read[AcademyMode](json("mode"))
304           Academy(mode)
305         case "Tavern" => Tavern
306   )

312 enum PoliticianEffect derives ReadWriter:
313   case WheatProductionMultiplier(multiplier: Double) // e.g., 2.0 = 2x wheat production
314   case WoodProductionMultiplier(multiplier: Double)
315   case FaithProductionMultiplier(multiplier: Double)

319 case class Politician(
320     id: String,
321     name: String,
322     title: String,
323     effect: PoliticianEffect,
324     emoji: String,
325     secondaryEffect: Option[PoliticianEffect] = None, // Rare politicians have two effects
326     tertiaryEffect: Option[PoliticianEffect] = None, // Rare politicians with Management3B have three effects
327     remainingLifespanMs: Long = 600000L // 10 minutes = 600,000 ms
328 ) derives ReadWriter:
329   def isRare: Boolean = secondaryEffect.isDefined
330   
331   /** All effects this politician has (1, 2, or 3) */
332   def allEffects: List[PoliticianEffect] =
333     effect :: secondaryEffect.toList ::: tertiaryEffect.toList
334   
335   private def describeEffect(eff: PoliticianEffect): String = eff match
336     case PoliticianEffect.WheatProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% wheat"
337     case PoliticianEffect.WoodProductionMultiplier(m)  => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% wood"
338     case PoliticianEffect.FaithProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% faith"
339     case PoliticianEffect.StoneProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% stone"
340     case PoliticianEffect.AllProductionMultiplier(m)   => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% all"
341   
342   def effectDescription: String =
343     val extras = secondaryEffect.toList ::: tertiaryEffect.toList
344     if extras.nonEmpty then
345       s"${describeEffect(effect)} + ${extras.map(describeEffect).mkString(" + ")}"
346     else effect match
347       case PoliticianEffect.WheatProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% wheat production"
348       case PoliticianEffect.WoodProductionMultiplier(m)  => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% wood production"
349       case PoliticianEffect.FaithProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% faith production"
350       case PoliticianEffect.StoneProductionMultiplier(m) => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% stone production"
351       case PoliticianEffect.AllProductionMultiplier(m)   => s"${(m * 100).toInt}% all production"

357 case class Tile(
358     coord: Coord,
359     tileType: TileType,
360     unlocked: Boolean
361 ) derives ReadWriter:
362   def isEmpty: Boolean = tileType match
363     case TileType.Empty => true
364     case _              => false
365 
366   def isWheatField: Boolean = tileType match
367     case TileType.WheatField(_) => true
368     case _                      => false
369 
370   def isFarm: Boolean = tileType match
371     case TileType.Farm(_) => true
372     case _                => false
373 
374   def isWoodcutter: Boolean = tileType match
375     case TileType.Woodcutter(_) => true
376     case _                      => false
377 
378   def isBureau: Boolean = tileType match
379     case TileType.Bureau(_) => true
380     case _                  => false
381 
382   def isTemple: Boolean = tileType match
383     case TileType.Temple(_) => true
384     case _                  => false
385 
386   def isTownHall: Boolean = tileType match
387     case TileType.TownHall(_) => true
388     case _                    => false
389 
390   def isQuarry: Boolean = tileType match
391     case TileType.Quarry(_) => true
392     case _                  => false
393 
394   def isAcademy: Boolean = tileType match
395     case TileType.Academy(_) => true
396     case _                   => false
397 
398   def isTavern: Boolean = tileType match
399     case TileType.Tavern => true
400     case _               => false
401 
402   def isBuilding: Boolean = isWheatField || isFarm || isWoodcutter || isBureau || isTemple || isTownHall || isQuarry || isAcademy || isTavern
403 
404   def isUpgradeable: Boolean = isWheatField || isFarm || isWoodcutter || isTemple || isQuarry
405 
406   def level: Int = tileType match
407     case TileType.WheatField(lvl) => lvl
408     case TileType.Farm(lvl)       => lvl
409     case TileType.Woodcutter(lvl) => lvl
410     case TileType.Bureau(lvl)     => lvl
411     case TileType.Temple(lvl)     => lvl
412     case TileType.Quarry(lvl)     => lvl
413     case _                        => 0
414 
415   def upgradeCost: Option[Cost] = tileType match
416     case TileType.WheatField(lvl) => Some(Cost(TileKingdomLogic.wheatFieldLevelUpCost(lvl), Resource.Wheat))
417     case TileType.Farm(lvl)       => Some(Cost(TileKingdomLogic.farmLevelUpCost(lvl), Resource.Wheat))
418     case TileType.Woodcutter(lvl) => Some(Cost(TileKingdomLogic.woodcutterLevelUpCost(lvl), Resource.Wheat))
419     case TileType.Temple(lvl)     => Some(Cost(TileKingdomLogic.templeLevelUpCost(lvl), Resource.Wood))
420     case TileType.Quarry(lvl)     => Some(Cost(TileKingdomLogic.quarryLevelUpCost(lvl), Resource.Wood))
421     case _                        => None
422 
423   def withNextLevel: Tile = copy(tileType = tileType match
424     case TileType.WheatField(lvl) => TileType.WheatField(lvl + 1)
425     case TileType.Farm(lvl)       => TileType.Farm(lvl + 1)
426     case TileType.Woodcutter(lvl) => TileType.Woodcutter(lvl + 1)
427     case TileType.Temple(lvl)     => TileType.Temple(lvl + 1)
428     case TileType.Quarry(lvl)     => TileType.Quarry(lvl + 1)
429     case TileType.Bureau(lvl)     => TileType.Bureau(lvl + 1)
430     case other                    => other
431   )

437 case class Island(
438     id: Int,
439     tiles: Map[Coord, Tile]
440 ) derives ReadWriter:
441   /** All tiles that are unlocked on this island */
442   def unlockedTiles: List[Tile] =
443     tiles.values.filter(_.unlocked).toList.sortBy(t => (t.coord.row, t.coord.col))
444 
445   /** All tiles that are locked on this island */
446   def lockedTiles: List[Tile] =
447     tiles.values.filterNot(_.unlocked).toList.sortBy(t => (t.coord.row, t.coord.col))
448 
449   /** Check if all unlocked tiles have buildings */
450   def allUnlockedTilesFilled: Boolean =
451     unlockedTiles.nonEmpty && unlockedTiles.forall(_.isBuilding)
452 
453   /** Check if all 15 tiles are unlocked */
454   def allTilesUnlocked: Boolean =
455     tiles.values.forall(_.unlocked)
456 
457   /** Check if this island is complete (all tiles unlocked AND all have buildings) */
458   def isComplete: Boolean =
459     allTilesUnlocked && allUnlockedTilesFilled
460 
461   /** Get unlockable tile coords (all locked tiles on this island) */
462   def unlockableCoords: Set[Coord] =
463     tiles.collect { case (coord, tile) if !tile.unlocked => coord }.toSet
464 
465 object Island:
466   val Width: Int = 3   // 3 columns (0-2)
467   val Height: Int = 5  // 5 rows (0-4)
468   val TileCount: Int = Width * Height // 15 tiles
469 
470   /** All valid coordinates for an island */
471   val AllCoords: Set[Coord] =
472     (for
473       row <- 0 until Height
474       col <- 0 until Width
475     yield Coord(row, col)).toSet
476 
477   /** Create a new island with all tiles locked */
478   def create(id: Int): Island =
479     val tiles = AllCoords.map { coord =>
480       coord -> Tile(coord = coord, tileType = TileType.Empty, unlocked = false)
481     }.toMap
482     Island(id = id, tiles = tiles)
483

488 case class TileKingdomGame(
489     islands: List[Island],        // List of islands (replaces tiles: Map[Coord, Tile])
490     currentIslandIndex: Int,      // Which island is currently being viewed
491     wheat: Double,                // Can be fractional for smooth accumulation
492     wood: Double,                 // Wood resource
493     faith: Double,                // Faith resource from temples
494     gold: Int,
495     stone: Double = 0.0,          // Stone resource from quarries
496     lastTickTime: Long,           // Timestamp in milliseconds for offline progress
497     totalAbdications: Int,
498     bureauMode: Map[Coord, BureauMode] = Map.empty,      // Bureau mode per coord (on current island)
499     bureauDirection: Map[Coord, BureauDirection] = Map.empty, // Bureau direction per coord
500     townHallDirection: Map[Coord, BureauDirection] = Map.empty, // Town Hall direction per coord
501     politicianRoster: List[Politician] = List.empty, // Available politicians to assign
502     lastPoliticianGeneration: Long = 0L,             // Timestamp of last politician generation tick
503     politicianGenerationProgress: Double = 0.0,     // Progress towards next politician (0.0 to 1.0)
504     legacyPoints: Int = 0,        // Legacy points: total tiles lost due to sailing (never decreases)
505     skillPoints: Int = 0,         // Skill points available to spend
506     unlockedSkills: Set[Skill] = Set.empty, // Skills unlocked via skill tree
507     hasSailed: Boolean = false,   // Whether player has sailed at least once (unlocks skill tree)
508     hasPlacedBuilding: Boolean = false, // Whether any building has been placed since last abdication/sail
509     tilePoints: Int = 0,          // Tile points earned by destroying tiles, used for free tile unlocks
510     totalSkillPointsEarned: Int = 0, // Cumulative skill points ever earned (for save recovery)
511     sailedCount: Int = 0,         // Number of times the player has sailed
512     sailTileThreshold: Int = 12   // Current tile threshold for sailing (starts at 12, increases with each sail)
513 ) derives ReadWriter:
514 
515   // ============================================================================
516   // Island helpers
517   // ============================================================================
518 
519   /** Get the currently viewed island */
520   def currentIsland: Island = islands(currentIslandIndex)
521 
522   /** Get all unlocked tiles across all islands (for production calculations) */
523   def allUnlockedTiles: List[Tile] = islands.flatMap(_.unlockedTiles)
524 
525   /** Total number of unlocked tiles across all islands */
526   def totalUnlockedTileCount: Int = allUnlockedTiles.size
527 
528   /** Total number of islands */
529   def totalIslands: Int = islands.size
530 
531   /** Check if can navigate to previous island */
532   def canGoPreviousIsland: Boolean = currentIslandIndex > 0
533 
534   /** Check if can navigate to next island */
535   def canGoNextIsland: Boolean = currentIslandIndex < islands.size - 1
536 
537   /** Check if current island is complete (all 15 tiles unlocked and filled) */
538   def currentIslandComplete: Boolean = currentIsland.isComplete
539 
540   /** Check if can unlock a new island */
541   def canUnlockNewIsland: Boolean =
542     currentIslandComplete && gold >= TileKingdomLogic.islandUnlockCost(islands.size)
543 
544   /** Get unlockable tile coords on current island */
545   def unlockableCoordsOnCurrentIsland: Set[Coord] = currentIsland.unlockableCoords
546 
547   // ============================================================================
548   // Tile accessors for current island (backward compatibility)
549   // ============================================================================
550 
551   /** Get tiles on current island (for backward compatibility with existing logic) */
552   def tiles: Map[Coord, Tile] = currentIsland.tiles
553 
554   /** Update a tile on the current island */
555   def updateTileOnCurrentIsland(coord: Coord, tile: Tile): TileKingdomGame =
556     val updatedIsland = currentIsland.copy(tiles = currentIsland.tiles.updated(coord, tile))
557     copy(islands = islands.updated(currentIslandIndex, updatedIsland))
558 
559   /** Update multiple tiles on the current island */
560   def updateTilesOnCurrentIsland(updates: Map[Coord, Tile]): TileKingdomGame =
561     val updatedTiles = currentIsland.tiles ++ updates
562     val updatedIsland = currentIsland.copy(tiles = updatedTiles)
563     copy(islands = islands.updated(currentIslandIndex, updatedIsland))
564 
565   /** Remove a tile from the current island (reset to empty locked) */
566   def removeTileOnCurrentIsland(coord: Coord): TileKingdomGame =
567     val resetTile = Tile(coord = coord, tileType = TileType.Empty, unlocked = false)
568     updateTileOnCurrentIsland(coord, resetTile)

646   def sailLegacyReward: Int = totalUnlockedTileCount

648   /** Skill points earned from sailing at current tile count */
649   def sailSkillPointReward: Int =
650     // Earn skill points for tiles above the threshold - 1 (minimum 1)
651     math.max(1, totalUnlockedTileCount - sailTileThreshold + 1)

656   // Skill helpers
657   def hasSkill(skill: Skill): Boolean = unlockedSkills.contains(skill)
658 
659   def canUnlockSkill(skill: Skill): Boolean =
660     if unlockedSkills.contains(skill) then false
661     else if skillPoints < Skill.cost(skill) then false
662     // Check if mutually exclusive skill is already unlocked
663     else if Skill.mutuallyExclusive(skill).exists(unlockedSkills.contains) then false
664     else
665       // Check prerequisites - either standard prerequisite or alternative prerequisites
666       val standardPrereqMet = Skill.prerequisite(skill).forall(unlockedSkills.contains)
667       val alternativePrereqMet = Skill.alternativePrerequisites(skill) match
668         case Some(alternatives) => alternatives.exists(unlockedSkills.contains)
669         case None => true
670       standardPrereqMet && alternativePrereqMet
671 
672   def totalSkillPointsSpent: Int =
673     unlockedSkills.toList.map(Skill.cost).sum
674 
675   /** True when no buildings have been placed since the last abdication/sail. */
676   def isFreshAbdication: Boolean = !hasPlacedBuilding
677 
678   /** A skill can be refunded if it is unlocked, no other unlocked skill depends on it,
679     * the player can afford the gold cost, and no buildings have been placed yet. */
680   def canRefundSkill(skill: Skill): Boolean =
681     if !hasSailed then false
682     else if !isFreshAbdication then false
683     else if !unlockedSkills.contains(skill) then false
684     else if gold < Skill.cost(skill) * TileKingdomLogic.SkillRefundGoldCost then false
685     else
686       // Check no other unlocked skill has this skill as a prerequisite
687       val dependents = unlockedSkills.filter: other =>
688         Skill.prerequisite(other).contains(skill) ||
689           Skill.alternativePrerequisites(other).exists: alts =>
690             alts.contains(skill) && !alts.exists(alt => alt != skill && unlockedSkills.contains(alt))
691       dependents.isEmpty

782   /** Navigate to previous island */
783   def previousIsland(game: TileKingdomGame): TileKingdomGame =
784     if game.canGoPreviousIsland then
785       game.copy(currentIslandIndex = game.currentIslandIndex - 1)
786     else game
787 
788   /** Navigate to next island */
789   def nextIsland(game: TileKingdomGame): TileKingdomGame =
790     if game.canGoNextIsland then
791       game.copy(currentIslandIndex = game.currentIslandIndex + 1)
792     else game
793 
794   /** Unlock a new island */
795   def unlockNewIsland(game: TileKingdomGame): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
796     val cost = islandUnlockCost(game.islands.size)
797     if !game.currentIslandComplete then
798       Left("Current island must be complete to unlock a new island")
799     else if game.gold < cost then
800       Left(s"Not enough gold (need $cost)")
801     else
802       val newIsland = Island.create(game.islands.size)
803       Right(game.copy(
804         islands = game.islands :+ newIsland,
805         currentIslandIndex = game.islands.size, // Navigate to new island
806         gold = game.gold - cost
807       ))
808 
809   /** Unlock a tile on the current island */
810   def unlockTileOnCurrentIsland(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
811     val island = game.currentIsland
812     island.tiles.get(coord) match
813       case None => Left("Coordinate not on this island")
814       case Some(tile) if tile.unlocked => Left("Tile already unlocked")
815       case Some(_) if !island.unlockableCoords.contains(coord) =>
816         Left("Can only unlock tiles adjacent to your territory")
817       case Some(tile) =>
818         // Use tile point if available, otherwise use gold
819         val cost = tileUnlockCost(game.totalUnlockedTileCount)
820         if game.tilePoints > 0 then
821           val updatedIsland = island.copy(tiles = island.tiles.updated(coord, tile.copy(unlocked = true)))
822           Right(game.copy(
823             islands = game.islands.updated(game.currentIslandIndex, updatedIsland),
824             tilePoints = game.tilePoints - 1
825           ))
826         else if game.gold < cost then
827           Left(s"Not enough gold (need $cost)")
828         else
829           val updatedIsland = island.copy(tiles = island.tiles.updated(coord, tile.copy(unlocked = true)))
830           Right(game.copy(
831             islands = game.islands.updated(game.currentIslandIndex, updatedIsland),
832             gold = game.gold - cost
833           ))

835   // ============================================================================
836   // Forest Group Cache (island-scoped)
837   // ============================================================================
838 
839   // Cache for forest group sizes, keyed by the set of woodcutter coordinates
840   // This avoids recalculating expensive flood-fill for every woodcutter every tick
841   private var forestGroupCacheKey: Set[Coord] = Set.empty
842   private var forestGroupCache: Map[Coord, Int] = Map.empty
843 
844   /** Get woodcutter positions from a game state */
845   private def woodcutterCoords(game: TileKingdomGame): Set[Coord] =
846     game.tiles.filter(_._2.isWoodcutter).keySet
847 
848   /** Get cached forest group size for a woodcutter, recomputing cache if needed */
849   def cachedForestGroupSize(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Int =
850     val currentWoodcutters = woodcutterCoords(game)
851     if currentWoodcutters != forestGroupCacheKey then
852       recomputeForestGroupCache(game, currentWoodcutters)
853     forestGroupCache.getOrElse(coord, 1)
854 
855   /** Recompute the entire forest group cache */
856   private def recomputeForestGroupCache(game: TileKingdomGame, woodcutters: Set[Coord]): Unit =
857     forestGroupCacheKey = woodcutters
858     var visited = Set.empty[Coord]
859     var newCache = Map.empty[Coord, Int]
860 
861     woodcutters.foreach: startCoord =>
862       if !visited.contains(startCoord) then
863         val group = findConnectedWoodcuttersRaw(woodcutters, startCoord)
864         visited = visited ++ group
865         val groupSize = group.size
866         group.foreach: c =>
867           newCache = newCache.updated(c, groupSize)
868 
869     forestGroupCache = newCache
870 
871   /** Raw flood-fill that works on a set of woodcutter coords (no game needed) */
872   private def findConnectedWoodcuttersRaw(woodcutters: Set[Coord], startCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
873     @tailrec
874     def floodFill(toVisit: Set[Coord], visited: Set[Coord]): Set[Coord] =
875       if toVisit.isEmpty then visited
876       else
877         val current = toVisit.head
878         val remaining = toVisit.tail
879         if visited.contains(current) then floodFill(remaining, visited)
880         else if woodcutters.contains(current) then
881           val newNeighbors = current.neighbors.diff(visited)
882           floodFill(remaining ++ newNeighbors, visited + current)
883         else
884           floodFill(remaining, visited)
885     floodFill(Set(startCoord), Set.empty)
886 
887   // Find all woodcutters in the same connected group as the given coord
888   def findConnectedWoodcutters(game: TileKingdomGame, startCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
889     def floodFill(toVisit: Set[Coord], visited: Set[Coord]): Set[Coord] =
890       if toVisit.isEmpty then visited
891       else
892         val current = toVisit.head
893         val remaining = toVisit.tail
894         if visited.contains(current) then floodFill(remaining, visited)
895         else
896           game.tiles.get(current) match
897             case Some(tile) if tile.isWoodcutter =>
898               val newNeighbors = current.neighbors.filterNot(visited.contains)
899               floodFill(remaining ++ newNeighbors, visited + current)
900             case _ =>
901               floodFill(remaining, visited)
902     floodFill(Set(startCoord), Set.empty)
903 
904   // Island-aware version: Find all woodcutters in the same connected group on a specific island
905   def findConnectedWoodcuttersOnIsland(island: Island, startCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
906     def floodFill(toVisit: Set[Coord], visited: Set[Coord]): Set[Coord] =
907       if toVisit.isEmpty then visited
908       else
909         val current = toVisit.head
910         val remaining = toVisit.tail
911         if visited.contains(current) then floodFill(remaining, visited)
912         else
913           island.tiles.get(current) match
914             case Some(tile) if tile.isWoodcutter =>
915               val newNeighbors = current.neighbors.filterNot(visited.contains)
916               floodFill(remaining ++ newNeighbors, visited + current)
917             case _ =>
918               floodFill(remaining, visited)
919     floodFill(Set(startCoord), Set.empty)
920 
921   // Calculate forest group bonus multiplier for a woodcutter
922   // Bonus escalates: 2 tiles = 10%, 3 tiles = 10+20=30%, 4 tiles = 10+20+30=60%, etc.
923   // Uses cached group size to avoid expensive recalculation every tick
924   def forestGroupBonusMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
925     val groupSize = cachedForestGroupSize(game, coord)
926     val n = groupSize - 1 // Number of other woodcutters in group
927     val totalBonus = n * (n + 1) / 2.0 * ForestGroupBonusPerTile // Triangular number * bonus per tile
928     1.0 + totalBonus
929 
930   // Calculate Wisdom1 bonus multiplier for quarries (25% more stone per neighboring forest)
931   def quarryWisdom1Multiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
932     if !game.hasSkill(Skill.Wisdom1) then 1.0
933     else
934       val neighboringForests = coord.neighbors.count: neighborCoord =>
935         game.tiles.get(neighborCoord).exists(_.isWoodcutter)
936       1.0 + (neighboringForests * 0.25)
937 
938   // Calculate Wisdom2 bonus multiplier for temples (50% more faith per neighboring forest)
939   def templeWisdom2Multiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
940     if !game.hasSkill(Skill.Wisdom2) then 1.0
941     else
942       val neighboringForests = coord.neighbors.count: neighborCoord =>
943         game.tiles.get(neighborCoord).exists(_.isWoodcutter)
944       1.0 + (neighboringForests * 0.50)
945 
946   // Maximum number of politicians a single Town Hall can hold
947   def townHallCapacity(game: TileKingdomGame): Int =
948     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Management3A) then 2 else 1
949 
950   // Get town hall direction (defaults to Center)
951   def getTownHallDirection(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): BureauDirection =
952     game.townHallDirection.getOrElse(coord, BureauDirection.Center)
953 
954   // Set town hall direction
955   def setTownHallDirection(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord, direction: BureauDirection): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
956     game.tiles.get(coord) match
957       case None => Left("Tile not found")
958       case Some(tile) if !tile.isTownHall => Left("Tile is not a town hall")
959       case Some(_) if !game.hasSkill(Skill.Management2B) => Left("Requires Management 2B skill")
960       case Some(_) =>
961         Right(game.copy(
962           townHallDirection = game.townHallDirection.updated(coord, direction)
963         ))
964 
965   // Get the set of coords affected by a town hall, considering direction skill
966   def townHallAffectedCoords(game: TileKingdomGame, townHallCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
967     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Management2B) then
968       val direction = getTownHallDirection(game, townHallCoord)
969       townHallCoord.rectangleInDirection(direction, TownHallDirectionLength, TownHallDirectionHalfWidth)
970     else
971       townHallCoord.neighborsWithinRadius(TownHallInfluenceRadius)
972 
973   // Find all Town Halls that affect a given coord (within their influence radius/direction)
974   def townHallsAffecting(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): List[(Coord, Politician)] =
975     game.tiles.toList.flatMap:
976       case (townHallCoord, tile) => tile.tileType match
977         case TileType.TownHall(politicians) if politicians.nonEmpty
978           && townHallAffectedCoords(game, townHallCoord).contains(coord) =>
979           politicians.map(pol => (townHallCoord, pol))
980         case _ => Nil
981 
982   // Helper to apply a single effect to a multiplier for a specific resource type
983   private def applyEffect(acc: Double, effect: PoliticianEffect, isWheat: Boolean = false, isWood: Boolean = false, isFaith: Boolean = false, isStone: Boolean = false): Double =
984     effect match
985       case PoliticianEffect.WheatProductionMultiplier(m) if isWheat => acc * m
986       case PoliticianEffect.WoodProductionMultiplier(m) if isWood   => acc * m
987       case PoliticianEffect.FaithProductionMultiplier(m) if isFaith => acc * m
988       case PoliticianEffect.StoneProductionMultiplier(m) if isStone => acc * m
989       case PoliticianEffect.AllProductionMultiplier(m)              => acc * m
990       case _ => acc
991 
992   // Calculate Town Hall bonus multiplier for wheat production at a given coord
993   def townHallWheatMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
994     townHallsAffecting(game, coord).foldLeft(1.0): (acc, entry) =>
995       val (_, politician) = entry
996       politician.allEffects.foldLeft(acc)((a, eff) => applyEffect(a, eff, isWheat = true))
997 
998   // Calculate Town Hall bonus multiplier for wood production at a given coord
999   def townHallWoodMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
1000     townHallsAffecting(game, coord).foldLeft(1.0): (acc, entry) =>
1001       val (_, politician) = entry
1002       politician.allEffects.foldLeft(acc)((a, eff) => applyEffect(a, eff, isWood = true))
1003 
1004   // Calculate Town Hall bonus multiplier for faith production at a given coord
1005   def townHallFaithMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
1006     townHallsAffecting(game, coord).foldLeft(1.0): (acc, entry) =>
1007       val (_, politician) = entry
1008       politician.allEffects.foldLeft(acc)((a, eff) => applyEffect(a, eff, isFaith = true))
1009 
1010   // Calculate Town Hall bonus multiplier for stone production at a given coord
1011   def townHallStoneMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
1012     townHallsAffecting(game, coord).foldLeft(1.0): (acc, entry) =>
1013       val (_, politician) = entry
1014       politician.allEffects.foldLeft(acc)((a, eff) => applyEffect(a, eff, isStone = true))
1015 
1016   // Count taverns within influence radius of a Town Hall
1017   def tavernsAffectingTownHall(game: TileKingdomGame, townHallCoord: Coord): Int =
1018     townHallAffectedCoords(game, townHallCoord).count: coord =>
1019       game.tiles.get(coord).exists(_.isTavern)
1020 
1021   // Calculate lifespan multiplier for a politician in a Town Hall based on nearby taverns
1022   def politicianLifespanMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, townHallCoord: Coord): Double =
1023     val tavernCount = tavernsAffectingTownHall(game, townHallCoord)
1024     math.pow(TavernLifespanMultiplier, tavernCount) // 2x per tavern, multiplicative

1026   // Count academies by mode (with Education2: all academies count for both modes)
1027   def countAcademies(game: TileKingdomGame, mode: AcademyMode): Int =
1028     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Education2) then
1029       // With Education2, all academies count for both modes
1030       totalAcademies(game)
1031     else
1032       game.unlockedTiles.count: tile =>
1033         tile.tileType match
1034           case TileType.Academy(m) if m == mode => true
1035           case _ => false
1036 
1037   // Count total academies
1038   def totalAcademies(game: TileKingdomGame): Int =
1039     game.unlockedTiles.count(_.isAcademy)
1040 
1041   // Calculate academy build cost
1042   def academyBuildCost(game: TileKingdomGame): Int =
1043     val existingCount = totalAcademies(game)
1044     val baseCost = AcademyBaseCost * math.pow(AcademyCostMultiplier, existingCount).toInt
1045     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Education1) then baseCost / 10 else baseCost
1046 
1047   // Calculate rare politician chance with academy bonuses
1048   def rarePoliticianChance(game: TileKingdomGame): Double =
1049     val academyBonus = countAcademies(game, AcademyMode.RareChance) * AcademyRareChanceBonus
1050     BaseRarePoliticianChance + academyBonus
1051 
1052   // Calculate politician generation speed multiplier from academies
1053   def politicianGenerationSpeedMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame): Double =
1054     val speedAcademies = countAcademies(game, AcademyMode.FasterPoliticians)
1055     math.pow(AcademySpeedMultiplier, speedAcademies)

1057   // Generate a random politician (possibly rare, possibly with extra effects from Management3B)
1058   def generatePolitician(seed: Long, rareChance: Double, hasExtraEffects: Boolean = false): Politician =
1059     val random = new scala.util.Random(seed)
1060     val isRare = random.nextDouble() < rareChance
1061     val (name, title, effect, emoji) = PoliticianPool(random.nextInt(PoliticianPool.size))
1062     
1063     // Pick a unique extra effect different from previously chosen ones
1064     def pickExtraEffect(excludeEffects: List[PoliticianEffect]): PoliticianEffect =
1065       val options = PoliticianPool.filterNot(p => excludeEffects.contains(p._3))
1066       options(random.nextInt(options.size))._3
1067     
1068     if isRare then
1069       val secondEffect = pickExtraEffect(List(effect))
1070       val tertiaryEffect = if hasExtraEffects then Some(pickExtraEffect(List(effect, secondEffect))) else None
1071       Politician(
1072         id = s"politician_${seed}_${random.nextInt(10000)}",
1073         name = s"$name the Great",
1074         title = s"Legendary $title",
1075         effect = effect,
1076         emoji = "⭐",
1077         secondaryEffect = Some(secondEffect),
1078         tertiaryEffect = tertiaryEffect
1079       )
1080     else if hasExtraEffects then
1081       val secondEffect = pickExtraEffect(List(effect))
1082       Politician(
1083         id = s"politician_${seed}_${random.nextInt(10000)}",
1084         name = name,
1085         title = title,
1086         effect = effect,
1087         emoji = emoji,
1088         secondaryEffect = Some(secondEffect)
1089       )
1090     else
1091       Politician(
1092         id = s"politician_${seed}_${random.nextInt(10000)}",
1093         name = name,
1094         title = title,
1095         effect = effect,
1096         emoji = emoji
1097       )
1098 
1099   // Legacy method without rare chance (for backwards compatibility)
1100   def generatePolitician(seed: Long): Politician =
1101     generatePolitician(seed, BaseRarePoliticianChance, false)

1103   // Generate a politician using game state to determine rare chance and extra effects
1104   def generatePolitician(game: TileKingdomGame, seed: Long, forceRare: Boolean): Politician =
1105     val rareChance = if forceRare then 1.0 else rarePoliticianChance(game)
1106     val hasExtraEffects = game.hasSkill(Skill.Management3B)
1107     generatePolitician(seed, rareChance, hasExtraEffects)
1108 
1109   def generatePolitician(game: TileKingdomGame, seed: Long): Politician =
1110     generatePolitician(game, seed, forceRare = false)

1112   // Check and generate new politicians based on elapsed time
1113   def generateNewPoliticians(game: TileKingdomGame, currentTimeMillis: Long): TileKingdomGame =
1114     // Don't generate politicians if there's no town hall
1115     if !game.hasTownHall then
1116       return game.copy(lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis, politicianGenerationProgress = 0.0)
1117 
1118     val maxRosterSize = maxPoliticianRosterSize(game)
1119 
1120     // Don't generate or accumulate progress if roster is full
1121     if game.politicianRoster.size >= maxRosterSize then
1122       return game.copy(lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis)
1123 
1124     val speedMultiplier = politicianGenerationSpeedMultiplier(game)
1125     val baseIntervalMs = PoliticianGenerationIntervalSeconds * 1000L
1126     val lastTick = if game.lastPoliticianGeneration == 0L then currentTimeMillis else game.lastPoliticianGeneration
1127     val elapsedMs = currentTimeMillis - lastTick
1128     
1129     // Calculate progress increment based on elapsed time and speed multiplier
1130     // Progress of 1.0 = one full base interval has passed (at 1x speed)
1131     val progressIncrement = (elapsedMs.toDouble / baseIntervalMs) * speedMultiplier
1132     val newProgress = game.politicianGenerationProgress + progressIncrement
1133     
1134     if newProgress >= 1.0 then
1135       // Generate politicians for each full progress unit
1136       val politiciansToGenerate = newProgress.toInt
1137       val remainingProgress = newProgress - politiciansToGenerate
1138       
1139       // Only generate up to the remaining space in roster
1140       val availableSlots = maxRosterSize - game.politicianRoster.size
1141       val actualNewCount = math.min(politiciansToGenerate, availableSlots)
1142       val newPoliticians = (0 until actualNewCount).map: i =>
1143         generatePolitician(game, currentTimeMillis + i)
1144       .toList
1145       
1146       // If we filled the roster, reset progress; otherwise keep remainder
1147       val finalProgress = if game.politicianRoster.size + actualNewCount >= maxRosterSize then 0.0 else remainingProgress
1148 
1149       game.copy(
1150         politicianRoster = game.politicianRoster ++ newPoliticians,
1151         lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis,
1152         politicianGenerationProgress = finalProgress
1153       )
1154     else 
1155       game.copy(
1156         lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis,
1157         politicianGenerationProgress = newProgress
1158       )
1159 
1160   // Discard a politician from the roster
1161   def discardPolitician(game: TileKingdomGame, politicianId: String): TileKingdomGame =
1162     game.copy(politicianRoster = game.politicianRoster.filterNot(_.id == politicianId))
1163 
1164   // Tick politician lifespans - only active politicians (in Town Halls) age
1165   // Returns the updated game and a list of destroyed politician names
1166   // Taverns in range slow down the decay by their multiplier
1167   def tickPoliticianLifespans(game: TileKingdomGame, elapsedMs: Long): (TileKingdomGame, List[String]) =
1168     val townHallCoords = game.tiles.toList.collect:
1169       case (coord, tile) if tile.tileType match
1170         case TileType.TownHall(pols) if pols.nonEmpty => true
1171         case _ => false
1172       => coord
1173 
1174     var updatedTiles = Map.empty[Coord, Tile]
1175     var destroyedPoliticians: List[String] = List.empty
1176 
1177     townHallCoords.foreach: coord =>
1178       game.tiles.get(coord).foreach: tile =>
1179         tile.tileType match
1180           case TileType.TownHall(politicians) if politicians.nonEmpty =>
1181             val lifespanMultiplier = politicianLifespanMultiplier(game, coord)
1182             val effectiveElapsedMs = (elapsedMs / lifespanMultiplier).toLong
1183             val (surviving, expired) = politicians.partitionMap: politician =>
1184               val newLifespan = politician.remainingLifespanMs - effectiveElapsedMs
1185               if newLifespan <= 0 then Right(politician.name)
1186               else Left(politician.copy(remainingLifespanMs = newLifespan))
1187             destroyedPoliticians = destroyedPoliticians ++ expired
1188             val updatedTile = tile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(surviving))
1189             updatedTiles = updatedTiles.updated(coord, updatedTile)
1190           case _ => ()
1191 
1192     (game.updateTilesOnCurrentIsland(updatedTiles), destroyedPoliticians)
1193 
1194   // Base production per harvest (wheat per 10-second interval) - without bonuses
1195   def baseWheatProductionRate(tile: Tile): Double = tile.tileType match
1196     case TileType.WheatField(level) => level * 5.0 // 5 wheat at level 1, 10 at level 2, etc. (per 10s)
1197     case _                          => 0.0
1198 
1199   // Base wood production per harvest (wood per 10-second interval)
1200   def baseWoodProductionRate(tile: Tile): Double = tile.tileType match
1201     case TileType.Woodcutter(level) => level * 3.0 // 3 wood at level 1, 6 at level 2, etc. (per 10s)
1202     case _                          => 0.0
1203 
1204   // Base faith production per harvest (faith per 10-second interval)
1205   def baseFaithProductionRate(tile: Tile): Double = tile.tileType match
1206     case TileType.Temple(level) => level * 2.0 // 2 faith at level 1, 4 at level 2, etc. (per 10s)
1207     case _                      => 0.0
1208 
1209   // Base stone production per harvest (stone per 10-second interval)
1210   def baseStoneProductionRate(tile: Tile): Double = tile.tileType match
1211     case TileType.Quarry(level) => level * 2.0 // 2 stone at level 1, 4 at level 2, etc. (per 10s)
1212     case _                      => 0.0
1213 
1214   // Legacy alias
1215   def baseProductionRate(tile: Tile): Double = baseWheatProductionRate(tile)
1216 
1217   // Production rate per second (for display and total income calculation)
1218   def productionPerSecond(tile: Tile): Double = baseWheatProductionRate(tile) / ProductionIntervalSeconds
1219   def woodProductionPerSecond(tile: Tile): Double = baseWoodProductionRate(tile) / ProductionIntervalSeconds
1220   def faithProductionPerSecond(tile: Tile): Double = baseFaithProductionRate(tile) / ProductionIntervalSeconds
1221   def stoneProductionPerSecond(tile: Tile): Double = baseStoneProductionRate(tile) / ProductionIntervalSeconds
1222 
1223   // Calculate farm bonus multiplier for a wheat field at given coord
1224   def farmBonusMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
1225     val farmBonus = coord.neighbors.toList.flatMap(game.tiles.get).collect:
1226       case tile if tile.isFarm => tile.level * FarmBoostPerLevel
1227     .sum
1228     1.0 + farmBonus
1229 
1230   // Agriculture2A: halves the wheat field production interval (2x faster harvests)
1231   // Returns the interval multiplier: 0.5 means half the normal interval
1232   def agriculture2AIntervalMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame): Double =
1233     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Agriculture2A) then 0.5 else 1.0
1234 
1235   // Agriculture1B: Farm bonus applies to forests at half strength
1236   def agriculture1BFarmBonusMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Double =
1237     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Agriculture1B) then
1238       val farmBonus = coord.neighbors.toList.flatMap(game.tiles.get).collect:
1239         case tile if tile.isFarm => tile.level * FarmBoostPerLevel * 0.5 // Half strength
1240       .sum
1241       1.0 + farmBonus
1242     else 1.0
1243 
1244   // Agriculture3A: Wheat field upgrade costs reduced by 99%
1245   def effectiveUpgradeCost(game: TileKingdomGame, tile: Tile): Option[Cost] =
1246     tile.upgradeCost.map: cost =>
1247       if game.hasSkill(Skill.Agriculture3A) && tile.isWheatField then
1248         cost.copy(amount = (cost.amount * 0.01).toInt.max(1))
1249       else cost

1254       val farmBonus = coord.neighbors.toList.flatMap(game.tiles.get).collect:

1269   // Production rate for a specific tile per second (with farm bonuses, town hall bonuses, and Agriculture2A interval)
1270   def productionRate(game: TileKingdomGame, tile: Tile): Double =
1271     val base = productionPerSecond(tile)
1272     if base > 0 then base * farmBonusMultiplier(game, tile.coord) * townHallWheatMultiplier(game, tile.coord) / agriculture2AIntervalMultiplier(game)
1273     else 0.0

1277     val base = woodProductionPerSecond(tile)
1278     if base > 0 then base * forestGroupBonusMultiplier(game, tile.coord) * townHallWoodMultiplier(game, tile.coord) * agriculture1BFarmBonusMultiplier(game, tile.coord)
1279     else 0.0

1360   // Island-scoped: Wisdom1 quarry bonus from neighboring forests
1361   def quarryWisdom1MultiplierOnIsland(game: TileKingdomGame, island: Island, coord: Coord): Double =
1362     if !game.hasSkill(Skill.Wisdom1) then 1.0
1363     else
1364       val neighboringForests = coord.neighbors.count: neighborCoord =>
1365         island.tiles.get(neighborCoord).exists(_.isWoodcutter)
1366       1.0 + (neighboringForests * 0.25)

1371     else
1372       val neighboringForests = coord.neighbors.count: neighborCoord =>
1373         island.tiles.get(neighborCoord).exists(_.isWoodcutter)
1374       1.0 + (neighboringForests * 0.50)

1376   // Island-scoped: Forest group bonus using island's woodcutters
1377   def forestGroupBonusMultiplierOnIsland(game: TileKingdomGame, island: Island, coord: Coord): Double =
1378     val groupSize = findConnectedWoodcuttersOnIsland(island, coord).size
1379     val n = groupSize - 1
1380     val totalBonus = n * (n + 1) / 2.0 * ForestGroupBonusPerTile
1381     1.0 + totalBonus

1383   // Island-scoped: Town halls affecting a coord on this island
1384   def townHallsAffectingOnIsland(game: TileKingdomGame, island: Island, coord: Coord): List[(Coord, Politician)] =
1385     island.tiles.toList.flatMap:
1386       case (townHallCoord, tile) => tile.tileType match
1387         case TileType.TownHall(politicians) if politicians.nonEmpty
1388           && townHallAffectedCoordsOnIsland(game, island, townHallCoord).contains(coord) =>
1389           politicians.map(pol => (townHallCoord, pol))
1390         case _ => Nil

1392   // Island-scoped: Town hall affected coords (using island-specific direction lookup)
1393   def townHallAffectedCoordsOnIsland(game: TileKingdomGame, island: Island, townHallCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
1394     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Management2B) then
1395       val direction = game.townHallDirection.getOrElse(townHallCoord, BureauDirection.Center)
1396       townHallCoord.rectangleInDirection(direction, TownHallDirectionLength, TownHallDirectionHalfWidth)
1397     else
1398       townHallCoord.neighborsWithinRadius(TownHallInfluenceRadius)
1399

1515   // Tier multiplier: 3x for every 10 levels (level 0-9: 1x, 10-19: 3x, 20-29: 9x, etc.)
1516   private def tierMultiplier(level: Int): Int =
1517     val tier = level / 10
1518     math.pow(3, tier).toInt
1519 
1520   // Cost to level up a wheat field
1521   def wheatFieldLevelUpCost(currentLevel: Int): Int =
1522     currentLevel * 20 * tierMultiplier(currentLevel) // Level 1→2 costs 20, 2→3 costs 40, etc.
1523 
1524   // Cost to level up a farm
1525   def farmLevelUpCost(currentLevel: Int): Int =
1526     currentLevel * 30 * tierMultiplier(currentLevel) // Level 1→2 costs 30, 2→3 costs 60, etc.
1527 
1528   // Cost to level up a woodcutter
1529   def woodcutterLevelUpCost(currentLevel: Int): Int =
1530     currentLevel * 25 * tierMultiplier(currentLevel) // Level 1→2 costs 25, 2→3 costs 50, etc.
1531 
1532   // Cost to level up a temple (costs wood)
1533   def templeLevelUpCost(currentLevel: Int): Int =
1534     currentLevel * 50 * tierMultiplier(currentLevel) // Level 1→2 costs 50 wood, 2→3 costs 100 wood, etc.
1535 
1536   // Cost to level up a quarry (costs wheat)
1537   def quarryLevelUpCost(currentLevel: Int): Int =
1538     currentLevel * 20 * tierMultiplier(currentLevel) // Level 1→2 costs 20 wheat, 2→3 costs 40 wheat, etc.
1539 
1540   // Cost to unlock next tile (starts cheap, scales up)
1541   // Tiles 0-4: fixed costs (25, 50, 100, 200, 400)
1542   // Tiles 5-14: doubles each tile (800, 1600, ..., 204800)
1543   // Tiles 15-29: +25% each tile
1544   // Tiles 30+: +5% each tile
1545   def tileUnlockCost(currentUnlockedCount: Int): Int =
1546     currentUnlockedCount match
1547       case 0 => 1  // Reduced from 25
1548       case 1 => 2  // Reduced from 50
1549       case 2 => 5  // Reduced from 100
1550       case 3 => 10 // Reduced from 200
1551       case 4 => 20 // Reduced from 400
1552       case n if n < 15 =>
1553         val baseCost = 20 * math.pow(2, n - 4).toInt // Doubles every tile (tiles 5-14)
1554         if baseCost > 100_000_000 then 100_000_000 else baseCost
1555       case n if n < 30 =>
1556         // After tile 15, grow by 25% each tile
1557         val tile14Cost = 20 * math.pow(2, 10).toInt // Cost of tile 14 (20 * 1024 = 20480)
1558         val growthFactor = math.pow(1.25, n - 14)
1559         val cost = (tile14Cost * growthFactor).toInt
1560         if cost > 100_000_000 then 100_000_000 else cost
1561       case n =>
1562         // After tile 30, grow by only 5% each tile
1563         val tile14Cost = 20 * math.pow(2, 10).toInt // 20480
1564         val tile29Cost = (tile14Cost * math.pow(1.25, 15)).toInt // Cost at tile 29
1565         val growthFactor = math.pow(1.05, n - 29)
1566         val cost = (tile29Cost * growthFactor).toInt
1567         if cost > 100_000_000 then 100_000_000 else cost
1568 
1569   // Gold reward for abdication based on total income rate
1570   def abdicationReward(totalIncomeRate: Double): Int =
1571     math.max(1, totalIncomeRate.toInt) // 1 gold per resource/second
1572 
1573   // Create initial game state
1574   def newGame(currentTimeMillis: Long): TileKingdomGame =
1575     val initialIsland = Island.create(0)
1576 
1577     TileKingdomGame(
1578       islands = List(initialIsland),
1579       currentIslandIndex = 0,
1580       wheat = 50.0, // Start with some wheat to build first field
1581       wood = 0.0,
1582       faith = 0.0,
1583       gold = StartingGold, // Enough gold to unlock first tile
1584       lastTickTime = currentTimeMillis,
1585       totalAbdications = 0,
1586       politicianRoster = List.empty,
1587       lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis
1588     )

1590   // Simple tick: just accumulate resources based on production rate (used for very short intervals)
1591   /** Simulate a single tick interval worth of game mechanics.
1592     * This is the core game loop that handles:
1593     * - Resource production (wheat, wood, faith, stone)
1594     * - Bureau auto-upgrades (proportional to elapsed time)
1595     * - Politician lifespan ticking
1596     * - Politician generation
1597     * 
1598     * @param game Current game state
1599     * @param elapsedMs Milliseconds elapsed since last tick
1600     * @param currentTime Current timestamp
1601     * @return Updated game state
1602     */
1603   def simulateSingleTick(game: TileKingdomGame, elapsedMs: Long, currentTime: Long): TileKingdomGame =
1604     val elapsedSeconds = elapsedMs / 1000.0
1605     
1606     // 1. Accumulate resources
1607     val wheatProduced = totalWheatProductionRate(game) * elapsedSeconds
1608     val woodProduced = totalWoodProductionRate(game) * elapsedSeconds
1609     val faithProduced = totalFaithProductionRate(game) * elapsedSeconds
1610     val stoneProduced = totalStoneProductionRate(game) * elapsedSeconds
1611     
1612     var currentGame = game.copy(
1613       wheat = game.wheat + wheatProduced,
1614       wood = game.wood + woodProduced,
1615       faith = game.faith + faithProduced,
1616       stone = game.stone + stoneProduced,
1617       lastTickTime = currentTime
1618     )
1619     
1620     // 2. Process bureau auto-upgrades (for all islands)
1621     // Calculate how many upgrades each bureau should perform based on elapsed time
1622     val bureauIntervalMs = BureauIntervalSeconds * 1000.0
1623     currentGame.islands.foreach { island =>
1624       island.unlockedTiles.filter(_.isBureau).foreach { tile =>
1625         val speedMultiplier = bureauSpeedMultiplier(currentGame, tile.coord)
1626         val upgradesThisTick = (elapsedMs * speedMultiplier / bureauIntervalMs).toInt.max(0)
1627         
1628         // Perform multiple upgrades if enough time has passed
1629         (0 until upgradesThisTick).foreach { _ =>
1630           bureauAutoUpgrade(currentGame, tile.coord, currentTime) match
1631             case Some((newGame, _)) => currentGame = newGame
1632             case None => () // Can't upgrade (no targets or not enough resources)
1633         }
1634       }
1635     }
1636     
1637     // 3. Tick politician lifespans
1638     val (gameAfterLifespan, _) = tickPoliticianLifespans(currentGame, elapsedMs)
1639     currentGame = gameAfterLifespan
1640     
1641     // 4. Generate new politicians
1642     currentGame = generateNewPoliticians(currentGame, currentTime)
1643     
1644     currentGame
1645 
1646   /** Tick the game forward to the current time.
1647     * 
1648     * Simulates all game mechanics by running the appropriate number of tick intervals.
1649     * For performance, caps simulation at 24 hours and uses adaptive step sizes.
1650     */
1651   def tick(game: TileKingdomGame, currentTimeMillis: Long): TileKingdomGame =
1652     val elapsedMs = currentTimeMillis - game.lastTickTime
1653     if elapsedMs <= 0 then return game
1654     
1655     // Cap at 24 hours to prevent extremely long calculations
1656     val maxSimulationMs = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
1657     val actualElapsedMs = math.min(elapsedMs, maxSimulationMs)
1658     
1659     // Use adaptive step size based on elapsed time:
1660     // - For real-time play (< 5s): use actual tick interval (500ms)
1661     // - For short offline (< 1 hour): use 5 second steps (bureau interval)
1662     // - For long offline (>= 1 hour): use 30 second steps for performance
1663     val stepMs: Long = 
1664       if actualElapsedMs < 5000 then (TickIntervalSeconds * 1000).toLong
1665       else if actualElapsedMs < 3600000 then BureauIntervalSeconds * 1000L
1666       else 30000L // 30 second steps for very long offline
1667     
1668     val numTicks = (actualElapsedMs / stepMs).toInt
1669     val remainderMs = actualElapsedMs % stepMs
1670     
1671     var currentGame = game
1672     var simulatedTime = game.lastTickTime
1673     
1674     // Run full tick intervals
1675     for _ <- 0 until numTicks do
1676       simulatedTime += stepMs
1677       currentGame = simulateSingleTick(currentGame, stepMs, simulatedTime)
1678     
1679     // Handle remainder
1680     if remainderMs > 0 then
1681       simulatedTime += remainderMs
1682       currentGame = simulateSingleTick(currentGame, remainderMs, simulatedTime)
1683     
1684     // Ensure lastTickTime is set to actual current time
1685     currentGame.copy(lastTickTime = currentTimeMillis)
1686 
1687   /** Shared validation and placement for all build actions on current island. */
1688   private def buildOnEmptyTile(
1689       game: TileKingdomGame,
1690       coord: Coord,
1691       tileType: TileType,
1692       cost: Cost,
1693       prerequisite: => Boolean = true,
1694       prerequisiteMsg: String = ""
1695   ): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1696     val island = game.currentIsland
1697     island.tiles.get(coord) match
1698       case None                                 => Left("Tile not found on this island")
1699       case Some(tile) if !tile.unlocked         => Left("Tile is locked")
1700       case Some(tile) if !tile.isEmpty          => Left("Tile is not empty")
1701       case Some(_) if !prerequisite             => Left(prerequisiteMsg)
1702       case Some(_) if !game.canAfford(cost)     => Left(s"Not enough ${cost.resource.toString.toLowerCase} (need ${cost.amount})")
1703       case Some(tile) =>
1704         val updatedIsland = island.copy(tiles = island.tiles.updated(coord, tile.copy(tileType = tileType)))
1705         Right(game.deduct(cost).copy(
1706           islands = game.islands.updated(game.currentIslandIndex, updatedIsland),
1707           hasPlacedBuilding = true
1708         ))
1709

1730   def buildTownHall(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord, currentTimeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1731     val cost = townHallBuildCost(game)
1732     buildOnEmptyTile(game, coord, TileType.TownHall(List.empty), Cost(cost, Resource.Stone),
1733       game.canBuildTownHall, "Build a forest first").map: baseGame =>
1734         // If roster is empty, generate a politician immediately

1739           baseGame.copy(
1740             politicianRoster = List(newPolitician),
1741             lastPoliticianGeneration = currentTimeMillis,
1742             politicianGenerationProgress = 0.0
1743           )
1744         else baseGame

1758   // Toggle academy mode between FasterPoliticians and RareChance
1759   def toggleAcademyMode(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1760     game.tiles.get(coord) match
1761       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1762       case Some(tile) => tile.tileType match
1763         case TileType.Academy(currentMode) =>
1764           val newMode = currentMode match
1765             case AcademyMode.FasterPoliticians => AcademyMode.RareChance
1766             case AcademyMode.RareChance => AcademyMode.FasterPoliticians
1767           val updatedTile = tile.copy(tileType = TileType.Academy(newMode))
1768           Right(game.updateTileOnCurrentIsland(coord, updatedTile))
1769         case _ => Left("Tile is not an academy")

1771   // Assign a politician from the roster to a town hall (adds to list, or replaces oldest if at capacity)
1772   def assignPolitician(game: TileKingdomGame, politicianId: String, townHallCoord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1773     game.tiles.get(townHallCoord) match
1774       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1775       case Some(tile) => tile.tileType match
1776         case TileType.TownHall(existing) =>
1777           game.politicianRoster.find(_.id == politicianId) match
1778             case None => Left("Politician not found in roster")
1779             case Some(newPolitician) =>
1780               val capacity = townHallCapacity(game)
1781               val (updatedPols, returnedToRoster) =
1782                 if existing.size < capacity then
1783                   (existing :+ newPolitician, List.empty)
1784                 else
1785                   // At capacity — replace the first (oldest) politician
1786                   (existing.tail :+ newPolitician, List(existing.head))
1787               val updatedTile = tile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(updatedPols))
1788               val updatedRoster = game.politicianRoster.filterNot(_.id == politicianId) ++ returnedToRoster
1789               Right(game.updateTileOnCurrentIsland(townHallCoord, updatedTile).copy(
1790                 politicianRoster = updatedRoster
1791               ))
1792         case _ => Left("Tile is not a town hall")
1793 
1794   // Remove a politician from a town hall back to the roster (by ID, or the only one)
1795   def removePolitician(game: TileKingdomGame, townHallCoord: Coord, politicianId: Option[String] = None): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1796     game.tiles.get(townHallCoord) match
1797       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1798       case Some(tile) => tile.tileType match
1799         case TileType.TownHall(politicians) if politicians.nonEmpty =>
1800           val toRemove = politicianId match
1801             case Some(id) => politicians.find(_.id == id)
1802             case None => Some(politicians.head) // Default: remove first
1803           toRemove match
1804             case None => Left("Politician not found in this Town Hall")
1805             case Some(politician) =>
1806               val remaining = politicians.filterNot(_.id == politician.id)
1807               val updatedTile = tile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(remaining))
1808               Right(game.updateTileOnCurrentIsland(townHallCoord, updatedTile).copy(
1809                 politicianRoster = game.politicianRoster :+ politician
1810               ))
1811         case TileType.TownHall(_) => Left("Town Hall has no politician")
1812         case _ => Left("Tile is not a town hall")
1813 
1814   // Swap politicians between two town halls (or move from one to an empty one)
1815   // Moves the first politician from source to target; if target is full, swaps with target's first
1816   def swapPoliticians(game: TileKingdomGame, fromCoord: Coord, toCoord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1817     if fromCoord == toCoord then return Left("Cannot swap with self")
1818 
1819     (game.tiles.get(fromCoord), game.tiles.get(toCoord)) match
1820       case (Some(fromTile), Some(toTile)) =>
1821         (fromTile.tileType, toTile.tileType) match
1822           case (TileType.TownHall(fromPols), TileType.TownHall(toPols)) if fromPols.nonEmpty =>
1823             val capacity = townHallCapacity(game)
1824             val movedPol = fromPols.head
1825             val fromRemaining = fromPols.tail
1826             if toPols.size < capacity then
1827               // Target has room: just move
1828               val updatedFrom = fromTile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(fromRemaining))
1829               val updatedTo = toTile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(toPols :+ movedPol))
1830               Right(game.updateTilesOnCurrentIsland(Map(
1831                 fromCoord -> updatedFrom,
1832                 toCoord -> updatedTo
1833               )))
1834             else
1835               // Target full: swap first politician
1836               val swappedPol = toPols.head
1837               val updatedFrom = fromTile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(fromRemaining :+ swappedPol))
1838               val updatedTo = toTile.copy(tileType = TileType.TownHall(toPols.tail :+ movedPol))
1839               Right(game.updateTilesOnCurrentIsland(Map(
1840                 fromCoord -> updatedFrom,
1841                 toCoord -> updatedTo
1842               )))
1843           case (TileType.TownHall(pols), _) if pols.isEmpty => Left("Source town hall has no politician")
1844           case (_, TileType.TownHall(_)) => Left("Source is not a town hall")
1845           case _ => Left("Target is not a town hall")
1846       case (None, _) => Left("Source tile not found")
1847       case (_, None) => Left("Target tile not found")
1848 
1849   // Level up any upgradeable tile (wheat field, farm, woodcutter, temple, quarry)
1850   def levelUp(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1851     game.tiles.get(coord) match
1852       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1853       case Some(tile) =>
1854         effectiveUpgradeCost(game, tile) match
1855           case None => Left("Tile is not upgradeable")
1856           case Some(cost) =>
1857             if !game.canAfford(cost) then
1858               Left(s"Not enough ${cost.resource.toString.toLowerCase} (need ${cost.amount})")
1859             else
1860               Right(game.deduct(cost).updateTileOnCurrentIsland(coord, tile.withNextLevel))
1861

1863   // Cycle bureau mode: Slow -> Turbo -> Disabled -> Slow
1864   def cycleBureauMode(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1865     game.tiles.get(coord) match
1866       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1867       case Some(tile) if !tile.isBureau => Left("Tile is not a bureau")
1868       case Some(_) =>
1869         val currentMode = game.bureauMode.getOrElse(coord, BureauMode.Slow)
1870         val nextMode = currentMode match
1871           case BureauMode.Slow => BureauMode.Turbo
1872           case BureauMode.Turbo => BureauMode.Disabled
1873           case BureauMode.Disabled => BureauMode.Slow
1874         Right(game.copy(
1875           bureauMode = game.bureauMode.updated(coord, nextMode)
1876         ))
1877 
1878   // Get bureau mode (defaults to Slow)

1880     game.bureauMode.getOrElse(bureauCoord, BureauMode.Slow)
1881 
1882   // Check if bureau is in turbo mode
1883   def isBureauTurbo(game: TileKingdomGame, bureauCoord: Coord): Boolean =
1884     getBureauMode(game, bureauCoord) == BureauMode.Turbo
1885 
1886   // Check if bureau is disabled
1887   def isBureauDisabled(game: TileKingdomGame, bureauCoord: Coord): Boolean =
1888     getBureauMode(game, bureauCoord) == BureauMode.Disabled

1890   // Bureau direction constants
1891   val BureauDirectionLength: Int = 5 // 5 tiles long in the chosen direction
1892   val BureauDirectionHalfWidth: Int = 1 // 1 tile on each side = 3 wide
1893 
1894   // Get bureau direction (defaults to Center)
1895   def getBureauDirection(game: TileKingdomGame, bureauCoord: Coord): BureauDirection =
1896     game.bureauDirection.getOrElse(bureauCoord, BureauDirection.Center)
1897 
1898   // Set bureau direction
1899   def setBureauDirection(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord, direction: BureauDirection): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
1900     game.tiles.get(coord) match
1901       case None => Left("Tile not found")
1902       case Some(tile) if !tile.isBureau => Left("Tile is not a bureau")
1903       case Some(_) if !game.hasSkill(Skill.Management1B) => Left("Requires Management 1B skill")
1904       case Some(_) =>
1905         Right(game.copy(

1907         ))
