1909   // Get the set of coords affected by a bureau, considering direction skill
1910   def bureauAffectedCoords(game: TileKingdomGame, bureauCoord: Coord): Set[Coord] =
1911     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Management1B) then
1912       val direction = getBureauDirection(game, bureauCoord)
1913       bureauCoord.rectangleInDirection(direction, BureauDirectionLength, BureauDirectionHalfWidth)
1914     else
1915       bureauCoord.neighborsWithinRadius(BureauRadius)
1916 
1917   // Calculate turbo faith cost based on target tile level (level × 10)
1918   def bureauTurboFaithCostForLevel(level: Int): Int = level * 10
1919 
1920   // Effective bureau wood cost per upgrade (0 with Management1A, reduced by 90% with Logistics1A)
1921   def effectiveBureauWoodCost(game: TileKingdomGame): Int =
1922     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Management1A) then 0
1923     else if game.hasSkill(Skill.Logistics1A) then (BureauWoodCostPerUpgrade * 0.1).toInt.max(1)
1924     else BureauWoodCostPerUpgrade
1925 
1926   // Effective bureau turbo faith cost (reduced by 90% with Logistics1B skill)
1927   def effectiveBureauFaithCostForLevel(game: TileKingdomGame, level: Int): Int =
1928     val base = bureauTurboFaithCostForLevel(level)
1929     if game.hasSkill(Skill.Logistics1B) then (base * 0.1).toInt.max(1)
1930     else base
1931 
1932   // Get bureau speed multiplier (0.0 = disabled, 1.0 = slow mode, 10.0 = turbo mode)
1933   def bureauSpeedMultiplier(game: TileKingdomGame, bureauCoord: Coord): Double =
1934     getBureauMode(game, bureauCoord) match
1935       case BureauMode.Slow => 1.0
1936       case BureauMode.Turbo => BureauTurboSpeedMultiplier
1937       case BureauMode.Disabled => 0.0
1938 
1939   // Bureau auto-upgrade: upgrade the tile with lowest upgrade cost within radius
1940   // Returns updated game and the coord that was upgraded (if any)
1941   // Compares costs numerically - all resources are treated as equivalent
1942   // In turbo mode: costs 100 faith + 100 wood per upgrade, auto-disables if not enough resources
1943   def bureauAutoUpgrade(
1944                          game: TileKingdomGame,
1945                          bureauCoord: Coord,
1946                          currentTimeMillis: Long
1947   ): Option[(TileKingdomGame, Coord)] =
1948     game.tiles.get(bureauCoord) match
1949       case Some(bureauTile) if bureauTile.isBureau =>
1950         val isTurbo = isBureauTurbo(game, bureauCoord)
1951         val woodCost = effectiveBureauWoodCost(game)
1952         
1953         // Find upgradeable tiles within affected area with their costs
1954         val nearbyCoords = bureauAffectedCoords(game, bureauCoord)
1955         val upgradeableTiles = nearbyCoords
1956           .flatMap(coord => game.tiles.get(coord).map(coord -> _))
1957           .filter((_, tile) => tile.isUpgradeable)
1958           .flatMap((coord, tile) => effectiveUpgradeCost(game, tile).map(cost => (coord, tile, cost)))
1959 
1960         // Check if we have enough resources for turbo mode
1961         // Faith cost is level × 10 (possibly reduced), so check against the cheapest upgradeable tile
1962         val canAffordWood = game.wood >= woodCost
1963         val minLevelTile = upgradeableTiles.minByOption(_._2.level)
1964         val minFaithCost = minLevelTile.map(t => effectiveBureauFaithCostForLevel(game, t._2.level)).getOrElse(Int.MaxValue)
1965         val canAffordFaith = game.faith >= minFaithCost
1966 
1967         // Auto-disable turbo mode if we can't afford wood or faith for the cheapest tile
1968         val gameWithTurboCheck =
1969           if isTurbo && (!canAffordWood || !canAffordFaith) then
1970             game.copy(bureauMode = game.bureauMode.updated(bureauCoord, BureauMode.Slow))
1971           else game
1972         
1973         val effectiveIsTurbo = isBureauTurbo(gameWithTurboCheck, bureauCoord)
1974 
1975         // Must have wood for the bureau fee regardless of what we upgrade
1976         if gameWithTurboCheck.wood < woodCost then 
1977           // Return game with turbo disabled if it was disabled
1978           if gameWithTurboCheck ne game then return Some((gameWithTurboCheck, bureauCoord))
1979           else return None
1980 
1981         // Filter to only tiles we can afford (including bureau wood fee for wood-cost upgrades)
1982         // In turbo mode, also check if we can afford the faith cost for each tile's level
1983         val affordableTiles = upgradeableTiles.filter: (_, tile, cost) =>
1984           val extraWoodNeeded = if cost.resource == Resource.Wood then woodCost else 0
1985           val canAffordUpgrade = gameWithTurboCheck.canAfford(cost.amount + extraWoodNeeded, cost.resource)
1986           val canAffordTurboFaith = !effectiveIsTurbo || gameWithTurboCheck.faith >= effectiveBureauFaithCostForLevel(gameWithTurboCheck, tile.level)
1987           canAffordUpgrade && canAffordTurboFaith
1988 
1989         // Select the tile with the lowest upgrade cost (comparing numerically)
1990         affordableTiles.minByOption(_._3.amount) match
1991           case Some((targetCoord, targetTile, cost)) =>
1992             // Perform the upgrade
1993             val upgradedTile = targetTile.withNextLevel
1994 
1995             // Deduct upgrade cost and bureau fee from the turbo-checked game
1996             val afterUpgradeCost = gameWithTurboCheck.deduct(cost)
1997             val afterBureauFee = afterUpgradeCost.copy(wood = afterUpgradeCost.wood - woodCost)
1998             
1999             // Deduct faith cost if effectively in turbo mode
2000             val turboFaithCost = effectiveBureauFaithCostForLevel(gameWithTurboCheck, targetTile.level)
2001             val afterTurboCost =
2002               if effectiveIsTurbo then afterBureauFee.copy(faith = afterBureauFee.faith - turboFaithCost)
2003               else afterBureauFee
2004 
2005             val newGame = afterTurboCost.updateTileOnCurrentIsland(targetCoord, upgradedTile)
2006             Some((newGame, targetCoord))
2007           case None =>
2008             // No affordable upgrade, but return game with turbo disabled if it was disabled
2009             if gameWithTurboCheck ne game then Some((gameWithTurboCheck, bureauCoord))
2010             else None
2011       case _ => None
2012 
2013   // Destroy a building on a tile (returns it to empty state, no refund)
2014   // If destroying a Town Hall, its politicians are returned to the roster
2015   def destroyBuilding(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2016     game.tiles.get(coord) match
2017       case None                         => Left("Tile not found")
2018       case Some(tile) if !tile.unlocked => Left("Tile is locked")
2019       case Some(tile) if tile.isEmpty   => Left("Tile is already empty")
2020       case Some(tile) =>
2021         val updatedTile = tile.copy(tileType = TileType.Empty)
2022         val returnedPoliticians = tile.tileType match
2023           case TileType.TownHall(politicians) => politicians
2024           case _ => List.empty
2025         Right(game.updateTileOnCurrentIsland(coord, updatedTile).copy(
2026           politicianRoster = game.politicianRoster ++ returnedPoliticians
2027         ))
2028 
2029   // Destroy a tile entirely (resets it to locked empty), awarding a tile point
2030   // If destroying a Town Hall, its politicians are returned to the roster
2031   def destroyTile(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2032     game.tiles.get(coord) match
2033       case None => Left("Tile not found")
2034       case Some(tile) if !tile.unlocked => Left("Tile is locked")
2035       case Some(tile) =>
2036         val returnedPoliticians = tile.tileType match
2037           case TileType.TownHall(politicians) => politicians
2038           case _ => List.empty
2039         Right(game.removeTileOnCurrentIsland(coord).copy(
2040           tilePoints = game.tilePoints + 1,
2041           politicianRoster = game.politicianRoster ++ returnedPoliticians
2042         ))
2043 
2044   // Abdicate: reset buildings on all islands, gain gold based on income rate
2045   // Can abdicate at any time (no restrictions)
2046   def abdicate(game: TileKingdomGame, currentTimeMillis: Long): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2047     val goldReward = abdicationReward(game.totalIncomeRate)
2048 
2049     // Clear all buildings but keep all islands and tile unlock status
2050     val resetIslands = game.islands.map { island =>
2051       island.copy(tiles = island.tiles.map { case (coord, tile) =>
2052         coord -> tile.copy(tileType = TileType.Empty) // Keep unlocked status
2053       })
2054     }
2055 
2056     Right(game.copy(
2057       islands = resetIslands,
2058       currentIslandIndex = 0, // Go back to first island
2059       wheat = 50.0, // Reset wheat, give starting amount
2060       wood = 0.0, // Reset wood
2061       faith = 0.0, // Reset faith
2062       stone = 0.0, // Reset stone
2063       gold = game.gold + goldReward,
2064       lastTickTime = currentTimeMillis,
2065       totalAbdications = game.totalAbdications + 1,
2066       bureauMode = Map.empty, // Reset bureau mode since bureaus are destroyed
2067       bureauDirection = Map.empty,
2068       townHallDirection = Map.empty,
2069       politicianRoster = List.empty, // All politicians are destroyed on abdication
2070       politicianGenerationProgress = 0.0, // Reset politician generation progress
2071       hasPlacedBuilding = false // Fresh abdication
2072     ))
2073 
2074   // Sail: second tier prestige - reset everything including gold, gain skill points directly
2075   def sail(game: TileKingdomGame, currentTimeMillis: Long): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2076     if !game.canSail then
2077       Left(s"Need at least ${game.sailTileThreshold} tiles to sail (have ${game.totalUnlockedTileCount})")
2078     else
2079       val tilesDestroyed = game.totalUnlockedTileCount
2080       // Legacy points track total tiles lost to sailing (only goes up)
2081       val newLegacyPoints = game.legacyPoints + tilesDestroyed
2082       // Skill points = tiles above threshold + 1 (minimum 1)
2083       val skillPointsEarned = game.sailSkillPointReward
2084       // New threshold is current tile count + 1
2085       val newThreshold = game.sailNextThreshold
2086 
2087       // Reset to single starting island
2088       val startingIsland = Island.create(0)
2089 
2090       val newTotalSkillPoints = game.skillPoints + skillPointsEarned
2091       val newTotalEarned = game.totalSkillPointsEarned + skillPointsEarned
2092 
2093       Right(game.copy(
2094         islands = List(startingIsland),
2095         currentIslandIndex = 0,
2096         wheat = 50.0, // Reset to starting amount
2097         wood = 0.0,
2098         faith = 0.0,
2099         stone = 0.0,
2100         gold = StartingGold, // Reset to starting gold
2101         lastTickTime = currentTimeMillis,
2102         totalAbdications = 0, // Abdications reset on sail
2103         bureauMode = Map.empty,
2104         bureauDirection = Map.empty,
2105         townHallDirection = Map.empty,
2106         politicianRoster = List.empty,
2107         politicianGenerationProgress = 0.0,
2108         legacyPoints = newLegacyPoints,
2109         skillPoints = newTotalSkillPoints,
2110         hasSailed = true, // Mark that player has sailed at least once
2111         hasPlacedBuilding = false, // Fresh sail
2112         totalSkillPointsEarned = newTotalEarned,
2113         sailedCount = game.sailedCount + 1,
2114         sailTileThreshold = newThreshold
2115       ))
2116

2118   def unlockableCoords(game: TileKingdomGame): Set[Coord] =
2119     game.unlockableCoordsOnCurrentIsland
2120 
2121   // Unlock a specific tile on current island (uses tile point if available, otherwise gold)
2122   def unlockTile(game: TileKingdomGame, coord: Coord): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2123     unlockTileOnCurrentIsland(game, coord)
2124

2126   // Unlock a skill from the skill tree
2127   def unlockSkill(game: TileKingdomGame, skill: Skill): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2128     if !game.hasSailed then
2129       Left("Sail at least once to unlock the skill tree")
2130     else if game.unlockedSkills.contains(skill) then
2131       Left("Skill already unlocked")
2132     else if game.skillPoints < Skill.cost(skill) then
2133       Left(s"Not enough skill points (need ${Skill.cost(skill)})")
2134     else if Skill.mutuallyExclusive(skill).exists(game.unlockedSkills.contains) then
2135       Left("Cannot unlock - mutually exclusive skill already chosen")
2136     else
2137       val prereqMet = Skill.prerequisite(skill).forall(game.unlockedSkills.contains)
2138       val altPrereqMet = Skill.alternativePrerequisites(skill) match
2139         case Some(alternatives) => alternatives.exists(game.unlockedSkills.contains)
2140         case None => true
2141       if !prereqMet || !altPrereqMet then
2142         Left(s"Prerequisites not met")
2143       else
2144         Right(game.copy(
2145           skillPoints = game.skillPoints - Skill.cost(skill),
2146           unlockedSkills = game.unlockedSkills + skill
2147         ))
2148 
2149   // Check if player can switch to a mutually exclusive skill (free, only on fresh abdication)
2150   def canSwitchSkill(game: TileKingdomGame, toSkill: Skill): Boolean =
2151     if !game.hasSailed then false
2152     else if !game.isFreshAbdication then false
2153     else if game.unlockedSkills.contains(toSkill) then false
2154     else
2155       // Must have the mutually exclusive skill already unlocked
2156       Skill.mutuallyExclusive(toSkill).exists(game.unlockedSkills.contains)
2157 
2158   // Switch from one skill to its mutually exclusive alternative (free, only on fresh abdication)
2159   def switchSkill(game: TileKingdomGame, toSkill: Skill): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2160     if !game.hasSailed then
2161       Left("Sail at least once to unlock the skill tree")
2162     else if !game.isFreshAbdication then
2163       Left("Can only switch skills before placing any buildings")
2164     else if game.unlockedSkills.contains(toSkill) then
2165       Left("Skill already unlocked")
2166     else
2167       Skill.mutuallyExclusive(toSkill) match
2168         case Some(fromSkill) if game.unlockedSkills.contains(fromSkill) =>
2169           Right(game.copy(
2170             unlockedSkills = game.unlockedSkills - fromSkill + toSkill
2171           ))
2172         case _ =>
2173           Left("No mutually exclusive skill to switch from")
2174 
2175   // Refund a skill: costs 1000 gold per skill point, only on fresh abdication
2176   def refundSkill(game: TileKingdomGame, skill: Skill): Either[String, TileKingdomGame] =
2177     if !game.hasSailed then
2178       Left("Sail at least once to unlock the skill tree")
2179     else if !game.isFreshAbdication then
2180       Left("Can only refund skills before placing any buildings")
2181     else if !game.unlockedSkills.contains(skill) then
2182       Left("Skill is not unlocked")
2183     else
2184       val cost = Skill.cost(skill)
2185       val goldCost = cost * SkillRefundGoldCost
2186       if game.gold < goldCost then
2187         Left(s"Not enough gold (need ${goldCost} 💰)")
2188       else if !game.canRefundSkill(skill) then
2189         Left("Cannot refund — another skill depends on this one")
2190       else
2191         Right(game.copy(
2192           gold = game.gold - goldCost,
2193           skillPoints = game.skillPoints + cost,
2194           unlockedSkills = game.unlockedSkills - skill
2195         ))
